reviews.x: What I expect from any scented products is a strong, natural and lasting scent. And I want something pleasant unlike some other cheap products. It's a real pleasure to use these Keomi soaps; I breath in these lovely soaps while I shower, that leave a lasting, wonderful, natural scent, even after I towel off. Great product that I highly recommend.

I received this as a Christmas gift last year and just bought it for the woman who bought it for me! I absolutely love it. I smell wonderful for hours after a shower, plus it's gentle on my old lady skin.
Beautiful presentation!  Great attention to detail helps the gift to be even more special. Especially impressed with the use of all natural ingredients. My wife will love it come Xmas morning

reviews.t: Beautiful, elegant, rich ... what more can I say
reviews.x: Beautiful scent, rich lather, lasts long and fantastic packaging.  Given as a gift to cancer survivor with dry, sensitive skin and she loves this soap.

reviews.t: Aromatic Wonderfulness in a Bar of Soap
reviews.x: When I first received the package of the Sample Set of Handmade soap by Keomi, I could smell the wonderfulness of them.  Each bar is extremely aromatic.  My husband keeps asking me where  the new diffuser is because they smell so strong, in a good way.  The Sample Set contains 4 different scents. Sea Breeze. Refresh your skin with this bar of soap. It contains Pure Olive Oil, Palm Kernel Oil, Avocado, Grape Seed, and Coconut Oil, as well as Cocoa Butter, Dead Sea Salt and Dead Sea Clay, Seaweed.

Well, Let me tell you I was WRONG! First the packaging was so sweet! every one of these soaps smell AMAZING! I can't even pick just one I like because they all captivate my soul! reviews.t: Just a little gift to let them know that I think they are both wonderful Mother's. They were just the thing I wanted ...
reviews.x: I ordered two of these for Mother's Day gifts for my daughter and daughter in law.  Just a little gift to let them know that I think they are both wonderful Mother's.  They were just the thing I wanted to let them pamper themselves a bit with their busy lives.  They are wrapped just beautiful and truly a special, wonderful smelling soap.  I love that they are organic.  My only regret is that I didn't order one for myself.  They were both thrilled with them.

reviews.t: This is a wonderful set of soaps that I bought for myself
reviews.x: This is a wonderful set of soaps that I bought for myself.  But when I got them, and saw the adorable box she packed them in, I knew that I would buy more for Christmas gifts, birthday gifts, etc., and of course, more for me too.  The soaps smell wonderful and has plenty lather when you use them. Thank you so much, I will definitely buy again~

I was surprised by how beautifully these soaps were packaged. I am definitely going to order at least two more sets as gifts. These would be wonderful to pamper new moms, for stressed girlfriends, or any one needing just a little extra thoughtful care. They make a lovely lather with a beautiful scent that will lift your spirits. Thank you!

This was the perfect gift for my sister who has everything!  She travels extensively and has used spa products from both domestic and international lines.  She is enjoying these soaps beyond measure and is planning to restock once the gift supply from her little sister runs out!  I think I scored a home run with Keomi soaps :)

reviews.t: Absolutely beautiful soaps! Not only was I contacted nicely by ...
reviews.x: Absolutely beautiful soaps!  Not only was I contacted nicely by the product maker, the manner in which these soaps are displayed make them perfect gifts!  Therefore, I bought six more boxes for Christmas and gifted myself the one I originally bought :-).  The smells are magical and the feel is divine! So worth the purchase!!

reviews.t: ... received this set as a birthday gift and am amazed by how wonderful it is
reviews.x: I received this set as a birthday gift and am amazed by how wonderful it is.  My favorite so far (I've used 3 of the 4) is the Green Tea.  I loved the smell of that one!  No residue left on skin, and works great on sensitive skin. The smells are amazing and they are FULL size bars!  I can't wait to order again and again

Bought this for a dear friend who is going through a health issue and I wanted to pick her up. The gift box was absolutely adorable...she hated that she had to open it. She loved the individual scents/bars. Would highly recommend this if you are looking for a cute gift for someone who's hard to buy for. She loved them!

reviews.t: I love these soaps and they are packaged so nicely I ...
reviews.x: I bought this as a "Thank you" gift and when I received it I was tempted to keep it. I am going to order another or maybe 2 as gifts and another for myself. I love these soaps and they are packaged so nicely I don't have to wrap them. The scents are beautiful.  Love that they are all natural also!

Purchased a four soap bar gift pack for my wife and she was so happy with the product. She has had a problem in the past with other soaps drying out her skin. She loves the way the Keomi bars make her skin silky smooth. Thank you so much for your great product and helping to make her happy. Dennis

reviews.t: Said the scents were amazing and the quality was evident the minute she opened ...
reviews.x: I just got off the phone with my mom for whom I bought these as a gift. She couldn't have raved more. Said the scents were amazing and the quality was evident the minute she opened the box. Even my dad raved about the way they smelled, and he's not a soap-scents kind of guy!

This beautifully packaged gift box of fantasticly fragrant soap was a wonderful gift that I was happy to give! Each bar of soap is a gift in itself, wrapped in elegantly designed paper. I highly recommend this as a gift you will be proud to give. I will be back for more!

The Keomi Skincare soap set is a wonderful find!  The soaps smell heavenly and I have now purchased more sets to give to friends and family.  They are presented beautifully in gift box, ready to present with no extra wrapping needed.  I highly recommend this purchase!

reviews.t: and she absolutely loved it. It was wrapped so pretty
reviews.x: I sent this as a birthday gift to a dear friend, and she absolutely loved it.  It was wrapped so pretty, and the scent of the soaps was wonderful.  I do recommend this as a gift for any female friend or relative on your gift list.  I will order it again.

I purchased your soap and hand lotion as a gift for my daughter, and she LOVES them!  She said the packaging was SO beautiful, the scents were amazing, the lotion makes her hands feel so soft and silky, and she will order some for her friends. Thank you!

All four bars are great. As described, they are full size soap bars. In addition, I also loved the beautiful packaging. I bought the soap bars as a Mothers' Day gift and it was received well. I am very happy with this purchase.

reviews.t: It has a pretty ribbon and dried flowers for additional giftiness
reviews.x: The gift arrived on time and packaged very securely. It has a pretty ribbon and dried flowers for additional giftiness, and the whole thing smells so wonderful! Skin feels great from the soap, too. Love it!

I purchased this soap set as a gift for my sister.  She loved the soaps, the unique presentation box, and the delightful smells.  I was very glad to find this set because I knew she would appreciate it.
I bought these soaps as a mothers day gift for my mom and she loved them. She loves the scents and the textures of the soaps. We would definitely make another purchase from this vendor in the future.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the soaps' beautiful, strong, and lasting scents.
Many reviewers highlight the attractive, gift-ready packaging and presentation.
The soaps are repeatedly described as gentle and suitable for sensitive or dry skin.
Reviewers commonly buy these as gifts and report recipients loving them.
Several reviewers appreciate the all-natural ingredients and rich lather.
